title: [29.X]-"Your license does not grant you the following permissions on TableData 17 G/L Entry: Modify" if you Update Registers from G/L Registers page for old entries with G/L Register No. = 0.
summary: The G/L Register table was updated to fix a permission issue that occurred when updating registers from the G/L Registers page for old entries with Register No. = 0.
key_points: Fixed permission error preventing modification of G/L Register records
Addresses issue with old entries having G/L Register No. = 0
Changes apply to W1, ES, and APAC localization layers
Affects the G/L Register table structure
